name: SaaS AI Tools

sources.title: Submit a listing - SaaS AI Tools

requirements: AI/SaaS tools only; form requires choosing one category from a fixed list (AI Detectors, Chatbots, Image & Art Generation, Writing, etc.)
Search the site first - duplicates are not wanted
No affiliate links, no newsletter or directory links
No automated submissions ('we do not accept submissions made through automated methods')
No bulk/spam submissions - a large volume of tools in a short period results in non-approval
All listings are human-reviewed before publishing
preparation: Product name, tagline, overview & description, URL
Payment type of the product: Free / Freemium / Paid
Key features and use cases (form fields)
Pick the correct category from their fixed taxonomy (incl. an NSFW category)
workflow: Search saasaitools.com to confirm the tool is not already listed
Fill Listing Details (name, category, tagline, description, URL) and Additional Details (payment type, key features, use cases)
Wait for staff review; listing is published once approved
watchFor: Explicit anti-automation rule - fill the form like a human, one listing at a time
A paid 'Get Featured' upsell exists (via saasgems.agencyhandy.com checkout) - it is separate from the free listing
Cross-promotion nudge to also post on AI Forums (aiforums.co)
The submit URL /submit redirects toward a listing-type selector; the working form is /submit-listing-2/
countsAsLive: The tool's listing page exists under saasaitools.com and appears in its listing-category archive.
unknowns: Whether the listing link is dofollow
Whether an account (Login/Sign Up links exist) is required to submit
